title: openvinotoolkit/openvino: run a model on the hardware you have
friendlyTitle: OpenVINO runs a model on the computer you already have.
summary: OpenVINO gained 246 stars on GitHub's daily trending list. The repo has 11,525 stars, under Apache-2.0. It is Intel's open toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference. The latest tagged release, 2026.4.1, is from 1 October, so today's climb is not a new release.
friendlySummary: OpenVINO gained 246 stars on GitHub's daily trending list. The repo has 11,525 stars, under a free Apache 2.0 license. It is Intel's open toolkit for making AI models run faster and putting them into apps. The latest tagged release, 2026.4.1, is from 1 October. Today's rise is not a new release.
whyItMatters: Use it when you want a model to run on a CPU, GPU, or other supported chip without keeping a separate serving stack for each one. Read the device support for your machine before you assume a speed gain. Trending is not a benchmark.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it when you want one toolkit to run a model on a processor, a graphics chip, or another supported chip. Read which devices your computer actually supports before you expect a speed gain. Being on the trending list is not a speed test.
